R7AG-moose-atv-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 10 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 1.3 ha, right here.

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1. Parts closed or LEH only (Maps F25, F39, F40)
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 11 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.2468, -126.95674, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.1 km on Ff1361, Ff5006 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 190 m SW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-18, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AG-moose-atv-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-18: about 206 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
